mentions.name: OpenReaders
mentions.description: A platform offering free graded readers for language learners, starting with Spanish. It leverages LLMs to create engaging, level-appropriate reading content and includes learner-focused features with an emphasis on user experience.
mentions.problem: It is surprisingly hard to find free, engaging reading content at your level when learning a new language, and even paid options are often not that great.
mentions.audience: Language learners who need reading material matched to their level
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on https://openreaders.com – a platform with free graded readers, starting with Spanish (my native language).
